title: jitso init adds .jitso/ to .gitignore when git does not ignore it, once
source: intended: jitso init, one command for every adoption step (owner request 2026-11-23)
intent: INTENDED behavior. .jitso/ holds local state (the launch log, drafts, backups) that is never committed, and doctor warns when git does not ignore it. init appends the line .jitso/ to the primary checkout's .gitignore (creating it when absent) and a second run leaves it alone.

stdout.equals: jitso init: nothing to do (JITSO is already set up here)
